description: The plot illustrates how BLEU varies with Average Lagging (AL) for four methods, shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0 to 10 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, and 10.0. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from about 18 to 29 with major tick labels at 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, and 28. The Consistency-CE line is light purple with circular markers and a dashed style, increasing from about 18.8 at AL≈0 to about 27.0 at AL≈10, with intermediate points near 22.8 (AL≈2.5), 24.5 (AL≈5), and 26.3 (AL≈7.5). The Inconsistency-CE line is darker purple with square markers and a solid style, rising from about 20.0 at AL≈0 to about 27.0 at AL≈10, passing through approximately 22.9 (AL≈2.5), 24.4 (AL≈5), and 26.3 (AL≈7.5). The Inconsistency-CE-MP line is blue with square markers and a dashed style, starting around 18.5 at AL slightly below 0, then increasing through about 21.8 (AL≈1.5), 22.9 (AL≈3), 24.6 (AL≈5), 26.3 (AL≈7.2), and ending near 27.1 at AL≈10. The Consistency-Bi line is red with star markers and a solid style, increasing from about 22.4 at AL≈1 to about 26.1 at AL≈3, then to about 27.3 at AL≈6, reaching about 28.7 at AL≈8.5, and slightly decreasing to about 28.5 at AL≈10.
